loop.check.dice_contradicts: Runtime check: your reply states roll numbers that are not what this turn actually rolled ({rolled}). Rewrite the narration with the numbers removed — the players read the real result off the dice frame — and make sure the outcome you describe is the one the engine graded.
loop.check.dice_forged: Runtime check: your reply states a dice result, but no dice tool ran this turn — those numbers came from nowhere. Roll it for real now (skill_check / roll_dice / this system's own check tool), then narrate the outcome according to the graded result the engine returns. Leave the numbers out of the prose: the players already see the dice frame.
loop.check.item_forged: Runtime check: your reply mentions an item the room tracks, but no item change was committed this turn. If a character acquired, handed over, lost, recovered, equipped or used the item, call the matching item tool NOW (grant_item, improvise_item, transfer_item, remove_item, use_item, equip_item, or another available item tool), wait for its successful result, then narrate the action. If the item was only mentioned (NPC dialogue, scenery) and its holder did not change, reply with exactly NONE — the confirmation stays engine-internal and is never shown to players. If you must correct the prose, rewrite it directly with no meta notes; your reply is shown to players verbatim.
loop.check.stale_scene_hud: Runtime check: your reply drew a scene/time heading — "{title}" — but this turn never updated the deterministic state the HUD reads. Call kp_note now to set current_scene/current_focus as needed, and game_clock to set or advance the in-game time. A decorative heading is fine; it just does not move the HUD, the tools do. Then continue without contradicting the original narration.
loop.max_rounds: The Keeper pauses for a long moment, still weighing several possibilities. Please try again in a moment.

loop.tool_result_truncated: […truncated: only the first {kept} characters of this result are shown. Narrow the query or ask for a specific part if you need more.]
